title: A lease expiring is not proof.
hook: A lease expiring does not prove nothing happened. It proves nothing.
thesis: A lease is a coordination mechanism, not an observation of reality. When a lease expires mid-work, Orca treats the effect as UNKNOWN and sends it through the reconcile path: kill the worker after output, lose the receipt after the effect, expire the lease mid-work, each with a defined recovery. This post teaches the reconciliation mindset in 30 seconds: the difference between guessing and knowing.
